# Data Model Max Ernst (Q138547468)

The data model of the exhibition **"Max Ernst" (Q138547468)** is based on Wikidata and is compared with established metadata standards.

## Mapping Wikidata → Standards

| Wikidata property | Meaning | Dublin Core | Schema.org | CIDOC CRM |
|----------------------|-----------|-------------|------------|-----------|
| instance of (P31) | Exhibition | dc:type | Event | E7 Activity |
| title (P1476) | Title of the exhibition | dc:title | name | E41 Appellation |
| location (P276) | Exhibition location | dc:coverage | location | E53 Place |
| creator (P170) | Artist or creator | dc:creator | creator | E39 Actor |
| main subject (P921) | Main subject | dc:subject | about | E55 Type |
| start time (P580) | Start of the exhibition | dc:date | startDate | E52 Time-Span |
| end time (P582) | End of the exhibition | dc:date | endDate | E52 Time-Span |
| curator (P1640) | Curator | dc:contributor | contributor | E39 Actor |
| official website (P856) | Official website | dc:identifier | url | - |
| language (P407) | Language | dc:language | inLanguage | E56 Language |

## Description of the Standards

### Wikidata

Wikidata serves as the starting point for the data model. The exhibition is represented by the item **Q138547468** and contains structured information such as the exhibition title, location, artist, exhibition dates, official website and language.

### Dublin Core

Dublin Core enables the description of cultural heritage objects through basic metadata elements such as title, creator, date, language and identifier.

### Schema.org

Schema.org provides structured metadata for websites. The exhibition can be represented as an `Event` and enriched with information such as its title, location, start date and end date.

### CIDOC CRM

CIDOC CRM is an international standard for documenting cultural heritage information. The exhibition is represented as an activity and linked with people, places and time spans.

## Conclusion

The mapping demonstrates how the Wikidata properties of the exhibition correspond to Dublin Core, Schema.org and CIDOC CRM. Using these standards improves interoperability and makes the exhibition data easier to exchange and reuse across different cultural heritage systems.
